provenance.selectionRule: Use DirectoryBrowser view, flow wiring, and lifecycle-heavy client tests as the Harness source; VCP remains a Candidate foundation with injected filesystem capabilities only.

candidateStatus: foundation-electron-active; source/lifecycle fixture covered, no VCP directory IPC or paired same-semantic Harness pixel diff

harnessContract.tree: headless Modal > header(title + breadcrumb/path editor) + Miller content(one listing column or selected parent + divider + child column) + footer(new folder + show hidden + cancel + open)
harnessContract.businessBoundary: listDirectory, createDirectory, onOpen and onClose are owner-injected capabilities; the browser neither owns Workspace adoption nor host filesystem access
harnessContract.liveness: superseding browse intent aborts its signal; close/reopen/dispose invalidate late listing and create settlements

vcpCandidate.productionConsumer: none; VCP directory IPC, dynamic-wallpaper selection and Workspace persistence are intentionally untouched
vcpCandidate.boundary: Candidate Lab only; dynamic-wallpaper selection, Workspace persistence, and directory IPC remain untouched
